name: alcuin
description: Ask ChatGPT, or the OpenAI or Azure OpenAI API, about the source files you choose, and keep each answer as a durable session.

tools.name: consult
tools.description: Run an Alcuin session through the API or ChatGPT in the browser, with the files you attach.

tools.name: project_sources
tools.description: List a ChatGPT Project's Sources tab, or preview which files an upload would add.

tools.name: sessions
tools.description: List recent Alcuin sessions or fetch one by ID.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait for a session to finish without polling.
